name: shopify-perf-toolkit
description: Whole-theme Shopify performance diagnosis, reviewed patches, rollback, real Lighthouse/PSI measurement and score acceptance

scripts.test:lighthouse: PYTHONPATH=scripts PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:execution: node --test tests/execution.test.mjs tests/batch-integration.test.mjs tests/measure.test.mjs tests/site-verify.test.mjs tests/run-evidence.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: PERF_KIT_BROWSER_TESTS=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/runtime-browser.test.mjs tests/demand-browser.test.mjs tests/performance-browser.test.mjs tests/p1-performance-browser.test.mjs tests/domain-browser.test.mjs tests/extended-browser.test.mjs tests/section-liquid-browser.test.mjs tests/theme-steps-browser.test.mjs tests/recovery-adaptive-browser.test.mjs tests/toolkit-evolution-browser.test.mjs tests/checkpoint-state-browser.test.mjs
scripts.test:theme-workflow: node --test tests/theme-steps.test.mjs tests/liquid-assets.test.mjs tests/resource-repair.test.mjs tests/recovery-cost.test.mjs tests/improvement-session.test.mjs
scripts.test:recovery-cycle: node --test tests/recovery-evidence.test.mjs tests/recovery-adaptive.test.mjs tests/formal-recovery.test.mjs tests/domain-engine.test.mjs tests/architecture-boundaries.test.mjs tests/performance-upgrade.test.mjs tests/resource-budget.test.mjs tests/formal-collection-evidence.test.mjs tests/recovery-cycle.test.mjs tests/improvement-session.test.mjs
